title: Section 99 — No reversal for error not affecting merits or jurisdiction — CPC 1908

content.heading: No decree to be reversed or modified for error or irregularity not affecting merits or jurisdiction
content.text: No decree shall be reversed or substantially varied, nor shall any case be remanded, in appeal on account of any misjoinder or non-joinder of parties or causes of action or any error, defect or irregularity in any proceedings in the suit, not affecting the merits of the case or the jurisdiction of the Court. Nothing in this section applies to non-joinder of a necessary party.
